contexts.text: The worst of all kings could represent; as... Nebuchadnezzar...
Nebuchadnezzar king of Babel () = that which is profane which vastates. AC 10227:12.
Nebuchadnezzar king of Babel () = the vastator of truth and good.
As Nebuchadnezzar... represented the Babylonish falsification of the Word, and the destruction of all truth there, it came to pass that his hair grew like that of eagles.
Hence even Nebuchadnezzar is called the servant of Jehovah.
Nebuchadnezzar king of Babel = the profanation of Divine truth...
By Nebuchadnezzar as king of Babel, in the beginning, is signified the Celestial Church and its increase even to the summit of wisdom...
Nebuchadnezzar king of Babel = the profanation of truth and its consequent destruction.
That the cupidities of the love of self and the derivative Falsities will devastate, is signified by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babel, he and his people ().
Whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babel hath smitten () = its destruction by the pride of Own intelligence.
Babel, and Nebuchadnezzar, here () = the adulteration and profanation of good and truth.
Nebuchadnezzar king of Babel = the evils and falsities which devastate.

By Nebuchadnezzar, or by the king of Babel, in the Word, are meant those who destroy all things of the Church by evils... and, in the abstract sense, the evils which destroy. That Nebuchadnezzar shall come and shall smite the land of Egypt = the destruction of the natural man as to all the goods and derivative truths from the Word.
By this state of Nebuchadnezzar is described the state of those after death who exalt themselves as gods over all things of the Church...
